main_text.p: & singulorum locorum theologico-rum, de quibus inter orthodoxos & pontificios à multis annis conten-ditur, quosque consule. comprimis locum de verbo Dei & scriptura s.[?] de Christo mediatore; de lege, de evangelio: libero arbitrio: justifica-tione: bonis operibus: precibus: de ecclesia: pontifice Romano. & si-milia.

Catalogum traditionum pontificiarum proposuimus in medulla papismi, de arce ac judice omnium controversiarum theologicarum pag. 182. 183, et aliquot sequentibus: & demonstravimus, illas è diametro scripturæ divinæ; atque adeo veri Dei & Domini nostri Jesu Christi gloriæ adversari.

Quantaitem sit impietas pontificum Romanorum: quàm intrepidè scripturæ divinæ canone aspernentur, quamque graviter in hunc usque diem prope modum in omnibus & singulis doctrinæ Christianæ articulis à veritate evangelicâ aber-rent, docuimus pag. 197. 298 et seq. ac pro-

page.notes: Right edge: a sliver of the facing page with small marginal notes, cut off by the scan; not transcribed. The first line begins with "&" as a continuation from the previous page. The "s." before "de Christo" is doubtful (printed as "f." or a similar mark, read as s.[?]). "Quantaitem" is run together in print as read; it may be "Quanta item". The catchword "pro-" is the start of the next page's first word.
